title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.18868v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. translated_title: Tev：利用密集进度奖励扩展长时程智能体环境
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体因其能够自主地（从数小时到数天）完成具有经济价值的任务而日益受到关注，这一能力对自动化发现和递归自我改进（RSI）至关重要。然而，开源模型在长时程任务上仍然表现不佳，主要原因是既缺乏训练数据也缺乏可行的技术方案，且两者的扩展都很困难：长而复杂的任务难以收集和验证，且其奖励是稀疏的。我们同时解决了这两个问题。首先，我们介绍了 Tev-Gym，这是首个具有可验证、密集、渐进式奖励的长时程智能体训练数据集——涵盖 7 个领域的 1,170 个经过验证的任务环境。它建立在“潜在世界优先”的方法之上：首先构建一个潜在世界，即任务领域、工作流程以及每一步之后预期状态的完整且正确的隐藏规范。然后，每个任务从这个规范逐步渲染为面向智能体的环境，从而……
tldr: 本文提出了 Tev-Gym——首个具有可验证、密集、渐进式奖励的长时程智能体训练数据集，通过“潜在世界优先”方法构建了涵盖 7 个领域的 1,170 个任务环境，同时解决了长时程任务训练数据稀缺与奖励稀疏两大难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards—1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains—built via a latent-world-first approach to tackle both the scarcity of training data and the sparsity of rewards in long-horizon tasks.
